name: CrowdStrike Falcon LogScale / NG-SIEM — IOC hunting
description: LogScale queries over Falcon telemetry events. Event names follow the #event_simpleName convention used by the Falcon Data Replicator and NG-SIEM.

templates.name: Outbound connections to the IP addresses
templates.description: IPv4 connect events. Add NetworkConnectIP6 if the estate carries IPv6 telemetry.
templates.body:
#event_simpleName = NetworkConnectIP4
| in(field="{{field}}", values=[{{iocs}}])
| table([@timestamp, ComputerName, UserName, FileName, RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort, ContextProcessId])
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)

templates.name: Connections summarised per host
templates.description: One row per host and destination, with first and last sighting — the shape you want when scoping.
templates.body:
#event_simpleName = NetworkConnectIP4
| in(field="{{field}}", values=[{{iocs}}])
| groupBy([ComputerName, RemoteAddressIP4],
          function=[count(as=Hits), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen),
                    collect([FileName], limit=10)])
| sort(Hits, order=desc)

templates.name: DNS requests for the domains
templates.description: Falcon DnsRequest events, including the resolved addresses.
templates.body:
#event_simpleName = DnsRequest
| in(field="{{field}}", values=[{{iocs}}], ignoreCase=true)
| table([@timestamp, ComputerName, UserName, DomainName, IP4Records, ContextBaseFileName])
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)

templates.name: DNS requests matching the domains (regex)
templates.description: Regex variant that also catches subdomains of the indicators.
templates.body:
#event_simpleName = DnsRequest
| DomainName = /{{iocs|regex}}/i
| table([@timestamp, ComputerName, UserName, DomainName, IP4Records])
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)

templates.name: Processes matching the hashes
templates.description: Execution telemetry. Falcon records SHA256 and MD5 on ProcessRollup2.
templates.body:
#event_simpleName = ProcessRollup2
| in(field="{{field}}", values=[{{iocs}}], ignoreCase=true)
| table([@timestamp, ComputerName, UserName, FileName, FilePath, CommandLine, {{field}}])
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)

templates.name: Files written matching the hashes
templates.description: Catches a payload dropped on disk even if it never executed.
templates.body:
#event_simpleName = /^(NewExecutableWritten|PeFileWritten|NewScriptWritten)$/
| in(field="{{field}}", values=[{{iocs}}], ignoreCase=true)
| table([@timestamp, ComputerName, TargetFileName, {{field}}, ContextBaseFileName])
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)

templates.name: Indicators in a command line
templates.description: Finds the indicator passed as an argument, which is how living-off-the-land downloads appear.
templates.body:
#event_simpleName = ProcessRollup2
| CommandLine = /{{iocs|regex}}/i
| table([@timestamp, ComputerName, UserName, FileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName])
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)
